race.comment: ASILAH (15) resumes from a lengthy break. Scored a dominant win on debut, then chipped away late to run fourth in a small field at Warwick Farm last February. Primed with the two good trials and can stalk the speed from the good gate. Genuine contender. DIVINE SECRETS (8) resumes after making good progress last time in. Wasn't pushed out in the two trials and maps to get the right run with the good fresh record. HERMAN SAID (6) tried hard first up on the heavy (10) surface with a game third over 1100m at Gosford in the small field. Claim helps from the awkward gate and can take a hand in the finish. CALL ME SASSY (9) at her top now fourth-up and a win looks imminent. Covered ground in the run and loomed strongly before her condition gave out over the final stages when third over 1300m at Kembla Grange. Visors go on and Berry retains the ride. Respect.
